title: User-ruling wiring untested: start_run era-1 start + live advance gate have zero coverage
evidence: app/main.odin:911: "app.state.era = app_start_era()    // the ruling's start era — Foundations (1); PP_DEBUG builds pin the streaming-surge override (run setup — the director + forecast schedule)"; app/main.odin:936: "app.state.advance_gate_enabled = true". No app test asserts either line: grep of app/*_test.odin for era/advance_gate shows only camera/gauge wiring assertions (app/pullback_test.odin:540 expects camera fields). core/advance_gate_test.odin:97 sets the flag manually: "s.advance_gate_enabled = true"; demos/box_spine.dem:22 pins the era explicitly ("era 1"), so no golden catches a revert either.
detail: The r3 ruling's two wiring lines are untestable by absence: reverting app_start_era() to the era-3 default or deleting the gate line passes every unit test, parity run and golden.
recommended_fix: Add an app test asserting post-start_run state.era == app_start_era() and advance_gate_enabled; run it under both PP_DEBUG settings to pin both when-branches of app_start_era.

title: box_check_draw/box_check_place never exercised box-on; ghost-vs-commit consistency unpinned
evidence: core/box.odin:188: "box_check_draw :: proc(state: ^Run_State, c: Cmd_Draw_Pipe, cat: ^Catalogs) -> Edit_Error {"; core/box.odin:205: "box_check_place :: proc(state: ^Run_State, c: Cmd_Place_Router, cat: ^Catalogs) -> Edit_Error {". Only call sites are app/input/exec.odin:135 and :321. Every test drive is box-off: app/input/exec_test.odin:73 "ictx.state = &st // the Box: box_apply_edit needs the owning run (box-off here — legacy free-build)"; harness/parity.odin:200 wires state but never sets box_enabled. grep shows zero tests calling box_check_*.
detail: The new pre-commit pricing gates run only their box-off pass-through in the whole suite; no box-on test pins check-.None implying apply-.None, so a check/charge drift ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add box-on tests: spool-short draw and unheld-tier place return the box error from box_check_*; a check-.None candidate commits .None through box_apply_edit.

title: Placement-refusal toast branch (the teach-by-consequence path) has no test
evidence: app/input/exec.odin:162-166: "} else {" / "// the Box's \"no\" must TEACH (the record: tutorial by" / "// consequence) — the era-3 bind is piece-side, so an" / "// unheld-tier placement is exactly the moment the toast" / "// exists for." / "inp.last_reject = err" / "inp.reject_tick = inp.tick". The only box-refusal input test is draw-scoped: app/input/exec_test.odin:233 "test_commit_draw_box_refusal_sets_last_reject :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {" which calls "commit_draw(&ictx)".
detail: Deleting the placement else-branch reverts placement refusals to silent and every test stays green; the Place_Release teaching moment the record centers on is untested.
recommended_fix: Mirror the draw test for Place_Release: box-on input with empty piece/spool stock must set last_reject, log nothing, and apply nothing.

title: Reworked Q7 crisis-stall gate runs only in the manual econ-check verb; wired into no automated gate
evidence: harness/econ.odin:366: "// crisis-stall (Q7, reworked per Perkins r1 W3): era 3 ACROSS the real"; harness/econ.odin:371: "econ_run_scenario(cat, 3, 6000, 42, &stats, \"crisis-stall\")". Only invocation is harness/main.odin:90 "if verb == \"econ-check\" {"; grep finds no econ-check/econ_check reference in .github/workflows/ci.yml, tools/ci-local.sh, tools/*.sh or any *_test.odin.
detail: The death-spiral proof (crises>=1 vacuity guard + dots_post_crisis) exists only behind a manual CLI verb; a tuning regression that reintroduces crisis-to-no-dots passes CI, ci-local and the unit suite.
recommended_fix: Wire econ-check into ci.yml/ci-local.sh (CPU-only, headless) or add a harness unit test invoking econ_check and asserting a zero-fail return.

title: ci-local.sh gate list no longer mirrors ci.yml after the golden-leg demotion
evidence: tools/ci-local.sh:10: "# The gate list mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml step-for-step — the workflow"; tools/ci-local.sh:61: "\"Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate)|tools/harness.sh run\""; tools/ci-local.sh:65: "\"Motion-readability activation (rlsw pixel: the alpha=0.5 glide midpoint)|tools/harness.sh motion-pixel\"" vs .github/workflows/ci.yml:93 "run: tools/harness.sh run --skip-raster" and ci.yml:106 "run: tools/harness.sh palcheck --structural".
detail: Gates 4-6 now run full raster legs CI no longer has; the file's own step-for-step contract is false and the ruling-shaped divergence is unrecorded.
recommended_fix: Repoint gates 4-5 to the --skip-raster/--structural CI forms, keep full raster as an explicitly labeled local-only ground-truth leg.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: Traced 13 delta behaviours: 8 FULL, 4 PARTIAL, 1 NONE. P0 4/5 (80%, start-era/gate wiring uncovered), P1 ~57% fully covered (ghost pricing API, placement toast, econ-gate automation missing), overall ~62% full coverage — below every FAIL threshold.
